app.description: The values shared by every app chart (library chart `app`), set by the cluster for all the apps with the `global-values` ConfigMap of the `apps` chart.

lldapUsers.description: The users of the cluster, the key is the user id.

lldapdn.description: The base DN of the LDAP directory of lldap.

scaling.description: The scale of the apps. Used in the values of the app charts as `"{{ .Values.app.scaling.replicas }}"`, which is replaced by an integer.

dbReplicas.description: The number of instances of the databases (the `instances` of the postgresql chart).

replicas.description: The number of replicas of the stateless parts (the pods that have no volume and no state of their own).

auth.description: The forward auth of the route: `none`, or `authelia`.

dependsOn.description: What the release waits for (`[ref:<release>]` by default). The Certificates and the Gateway API CRDs are added.

enabled.description: `false` disables the release of the exposure.

hostname.description: The subdomain of `app.domain` (the id by default). A value with a dot is used as it is.

port.description: The port of the Service (not set by default).

release.description: The hostnames of a same release are exposed together, as `<release>-integration` (the id by default).

service.description: The name of the Service that gets the requests (`ref:<id>` by default).

timeouts.description: The timeouts of the HTTPRoute rule (ex: `{request: 0s}`).

expose.description: The public exposure of the app by the shared Gateway: the key is the id of an exposed hostname. Generates the Certificate, the listener of the ListenerSet and the HTTPRoute, in the release `<release>-integration`.

clientIdKey.description: The key of the client id in the Secret created by the ExternalSecret.

externalSecret.description: `false` does not create the ExternalSecret, the chart has its own with the SecretStore `authelia`.

name.description: The name of the ExternalSecret and of its Secret (`<id>-oidc` by default).

release.description: The release that gets the ServiceAccount, the SecretStore and the ExternalSecret (`<id>-pre` by default), merged with the one of the chart.

oidc.description: The OIDC clients of authelia the app uses: the key is the id of the client (see `oidcClients` in app-authelia).
